patch_description: The current pipeline already reaches ~0.98 of the reference squared ratio (1/4.1658). The remaining gap is best closed by (a) broader multi-start coverage — adding two additional high-quality structured seeds (cuboctahedron-based, scaled icosahedron + equatorial pair) and more random starts, and (b) polishing more of the top-ranked candidates with the exact constrained SLSQP solver (top 5 → top 8), since the SLSQP packing formulation is what converges to the true optimum basin. Additionally, I add cheap shape/finiteness assertions (per the recommendation) around the SLSQP and repulsion outputs so a malformed candidate can never zero out the run, and a final "best-of" re-polish that re-runs SLSQP on the incumbent to squeeze out the last digits. These are low-cost, targeted changes that preserve the existing 19s runtime profile while nudging the ratio upward.
